title: Slash foundation bento
description: An 88px centred serif heading with an italic word, a grey line, then a bento of dark slate product cards with 10px corners: two side by side with art above a semibold title and grey copy, and one wide card whose art fills it behind tier chips and copy at its lower left; small grey print underneath.
notes: card art slots take renders or screenshots; soft washes stand in when empty
